job_spec.name: hing_piped_b-6af1e12c2-tc
job_spec.purpose: hfd_host_ingest rev d (6af1e12c2, claude/sys-takeover-hostnative-d-20261009): hing_pipec_b TT -113.67 attributed: acked >= hk_d -> hr_q 28 lv, acked + ack_n 24, u_x qr -> S*3856 -> w1 24, w1 -> row -> w2 28, st_d -> ap1_rbase 31 -> RPIPE 2 (registered ack_n, split counter, registered compare), translator XPIPE (4 stages, 8-entry output FIFO), engine APIPE 3. Bench +5.6 % cycles. Variant b (HM 0).

bench.name: hhing_exact_fence
bench.cmd: OT_HING_DEFS='-DOT_HING_HCUT -DOT_HING_ETRIM -DOT_HING_APIPE3 -DOT_HING_RPIPE2 -DOT_HING_XPIPE' python3 tools/rtl_hbm_host_ingest_bench.py --work /tmp/hhing_{NAME} --output {RUN}/bench/hbm_ingest.json > {RUN}/bench.txt 2>&1; grep -q '^pass: True' {RUN}/bench.txt && echo HHING_PASS

bench.name: hhing_neg
bench.cmd: grep -q 'mutant window_ring_slot_plus_one detected' {RUN}/bench.txt && grep -q 'mutant completion_fence_removed detected' {RUN}/bench.txt && echo HHING_NEG_FAIL && exit 1; exit 0

bench.name: hhing_hcut_nofence_mutant
bench.cmd: OT_HING_DEFS='-DOT_HING_HCUT -DOT_HING_ETRIM -DOT_HING_APIPE3 -DOT_HING_RPIPE2 -DOT_HING_XPIPE -DOT_HING_MUT_GESTALE' python3 tools/rtl_hbm_host_ingest_bench.py --work /tmp/hhingm_{NAME} --output {RUN}/bench/hbm_ingest_mut.json > {RUN}/bench_mut.txt 2>&1; grep -q '^pass: True' {RUN}/bench_mut.txt && echo NOT_DETECTED && exit 0; echo HCUT_MUT_DETECTED; exit 1

bench.name: hhing_apstale_mutant
bench.cmd: OT_HING_DEFS='-DOT_HING_HCUT -DOT_HING_ETRIM -DOT_HING_APIPE3 -DOT_HING_RPIPE2 -DOT_HING_XPIPE -DOT_ING_MUT_APSTALE' python3 tools/rtl_hbm_host_ingest_bench.py --work /tmp/hhinga_{NAME} --output {RUN}/bench/hbm_ingest_ap.json > {RUN}/bench_ap.txt 2>&1; grep -q '^pass: True' {RUN}/bench_ap.txt && echo NOT_DETECTED && exit 0; echo APSTALE_MUT_DETECTED; exit 1
